get.summary: The server's version and its link to the engine host.

post.summary: Opens or closes a plugin's own editor window on the machine the engine runs on (the desktop app); 409 when the plugin has none or the engine runs headless.

get.summary: Recently opened projects, most recent first.

post.summary: Creates a project folder and opens it, closing the open one (unsaved edits are kept in its backup).
Opens a project folder, closing the open one.

get.summary: The open project, with its revision as the ETag; 404 when none is open.

post.summary: Applies a batch of edits atomically as one undo step. With If-Match, a stale revision answers 409; an edit that does not apply (an unknown id, a split outside the region) answers 422 and changes nothing.
Undoes the last edit; 422 when there is nothing to undo.
Copies an uploaded WAV into the project's Audio Files folder (a browser on the network).
Copies a WAV from the server's disk into the project's Audio Files folder (the desktop app).

get.summary: Waveform peaks of a file in the binary format of PeakFormat (Anode.Contracts), at the nearest kept resolution to framesPerPeak, optionally only peaks start … start + count.

post.summary: Play, stop, record or locate. Recording needs an open project and a record-armed track.
Flashback Capture: what the armed tracks heard during the last playback becomes a recording (an undoable step, announced as projectChanged).

get.summary: Every plugin the engine can load, built-in first; empty while no engine is connected.

post.summary: Rescans the CLAP folders; pluginsChanged follows on /ws when the catalogue is in.

get.summary: The MIDI ports of the machine the engine runs on.

post.summary: Plays MIDI on an instrument or external MIDI track now, as a keyboard would (and records it when the track is armed and recording).
Sends live MIDI to this track when no instrument track is record-armed (the selected track).
Saves the open project as a new alternative and makes it current.
Switches to another alternative (unsaved edits are kept in a backup first).

delete.summary: Deletes an alternative other than the current one.

post.summary: Replaces the open project with a backup of it (an undoable step is not kept: like reopening).

put.summary: Saves screenset 1…9 in the project (not an undo step; it marks the project unsaved).

post.summary: Imports a Standard MIDI File from the server's disk as new instrument tracks with its tempo and signature events, as one undoable step.

get.summary: The user's key bindings; empty bindings mean the editor's defaults.
A folder on the server's disk (the user's home when path is left out).

post.summary: Plays an audio file through the engine's preview channel; a null path stops it.
Starts a bounce (export) job; its progress streams as job events on /ws.
Renders a track's source and inserts to a file and plays that instead (an undoable step when it finishes).

get.summary: The user's saved channel-strip patches, by category.

post.summary: Saves a track's instrument, inserts and sends as a patch.

get.summary: A file's cached analysis: transients and beats (analysed now when missing), and its pitch curve and notes once an analyze job has run.

post.summary: Starts pitch analysis of a file (Flex Pitch) as a job; an analysis event on /ws follows when it is cached.
Renders tracks or regions in place to new files; when the job finishes, adds a track or replaces the regions and leaves, mutes or deletes the source, in one undo step.
Selection-based processing: runs a chain of built-in effects over part of regions; when the job finishes, that part becomes a new file and region, in one undo step.

get.summary: Searches the loop index (installed packs and the user's loops) by text, tags (all of them), kind (a LoopKind), key (a tonic 0…11), scale (a LoopScale) and favourites, a page at a time (offset, limit: 100 by default, at most 500), sorted by name.

post.summary: Add to Loop Library: saves a region of the open project as a user loop, with a sidecar, in the index.
Plays a loop through the preview channel at the project's tempo and key, starting on the next bar while the transport plays; POST /files/preview with a null path stops it.

put.summary: Marks a loop a favourite, or not.

post.summary: Installs a .anodepack from the server's disk and adds its loops to the index.

delete.summary: Removes an installed pack and its loops from the index; projects keep the copies of the loops they use.

post.summary: Adds a loop to the open project (its file copied in), following the project's tempo and key, at a position or into a Live Loops cell, as one undoable step.
Launches Live Loops cells or a scene at their quantise boundaries; cell events on /ws report their states.
Stops the cells playing on some tracks (or every track) at the grid's quantise boundary.
Starts or stops recording into a cell, or a performance recording into the Tracks area (one undo step when it stops).

get.summary: The groove templates saved in the user library.

post.summary: Saves a groove template in the user library (replacing the one with its id).

delete.summary: Deletes a groove template from the user library; projects keep their copies.

get.summary: The MIDI Transform factory presets (ids factory.…) followed by the user's saved sets, by name.

post.summary: Saves a MIDI Transform set in the user library (replacing the one with its id; a factory preset's id is refused: save a copy under a new id).

delete.summary: Deletes a user MIDI Transform set (factory presets cannot be deleted).

get.summary: The articulation sets saved in the user library.

post.summary: Saves an articulation set in the user library (replacing the one with its id).

delete.summary: Deletes an articulation set from the user library; projects keep their copies.

post.summary: Runs an Audio File Editor operation on a file as an audioEdit job: it writes a new version of the file and, when it finishes, points the file at it in one undo step (undo points it back).
Loop search over a range of a file: the best loops found, best first.

get.summary: Samples of a file's current version for the Audio File Editor: frames from start, raw (bucket 1, the default) or as min and max per bucket of frames; at most 65536 values per channel.

post.summary: Plays a range of a file through the preview channel, looping if asked; POST /files/preview with a null path stops it.

get.summary: The step input state (not part of the project: not saved, not undoable).

put.summary: Changes the step input state (left-out properties stay); a stepInput event on /ws reports it. Steps are the stepNotes and stepTie commands.

post.summary: A rest: advances the step position by one step (not an edit).

AddLoopRequest.description:
Adds a loop to the open project, as one undoable step: at `tick` on `trackId` (left out: a new track
of the loop's kind), or, with `cellSceneId`, into the Live Loops cell of `trackId` and that scene.

AddToLoopLibraryRequest.description:
"Add to Loop Library": saves an audio, MIDI or pattern region as a user loop (its file copied into the library,
with a sidecar), at the project's tempo, with the given key (a tonic 0…11; null: none), scale (null: neither)
and tags; as a one-shot (no tempo) when `oneShot`.

ArrangementMarker.description:
A section of the song on the arrangement track (Intro, Verse, Chorus). Sections do not overlap; moving or copying
one with `moveSection` moves or copies everything in its time range.

Articulation.description: An articulation of a set: its id (1…254, unique in the set), its name, and a short symbol (null: none).

ArticulationOutput.description:
An output of articulation `articulationId`: sent at the note's tick, sorted before it, on the note's channel
(an articulation may have several outputs; they play in list order).

ArticulationOutputKind.description: What an articulation sends before each of its notes.

ArticulationSet.description:
An articulation set (Logic's Articulation Set): articulations, input switches and outputs. Ids start with
`ars_`; sets live in the project (`Project.articulationSets`, a track naming one in
`articulationSetId`) and in the user library (`/library/articulation-sets`).

ArticulationSwitch.description:
An input switch: while recording (or playing live) a track with the set, this MIDI selects articulation
`articulationId` for the notes that follow; the switch itself is neither recorded nor played.

ArticulationSwitchKind.description: The kind of MIDI an articulation switch listens for.

AudioEditKind.description: An Audio File Editor operation (docs/08-phase-7.md, "Audio File Editor").

AudioEditOperation.description:
An operation on frames `startFrame` (inclusive) … `endFrame` (exclusive) of a file, every channel.
`value`: normalize's peak (dBFS, default −1) or gain's change (dB); `curve`: a fade's curve (default
0); `targetRate`: convertRate's rate. Posted to `/project/files/{fileId}/edit`, it runs as an
`audioEdit` job that reads the file's current version and writes `<name>.v<N>.wav` beside
it; when it finishes, the server applies SetFileVersionCommand (with the region shifts a trim or
rate conversion needs) as one undo step and recomputes the peaks.

AudioFile.description:
An audio file of the project; `path` is relative to the project folder. `tempo` is its File Tempo
(Smart Tempo), null until analysed. `version` (Phase 7) counts the Audio File Editor's operations on it: 0
is the file as imported or recorded; operation N wrote `path` as `<name>.vN.wav` beside it, and
undo points `path` and `version` back at the previous one.

AudioRegion.description:
A region of an audio file on a track: it starts at `startTick` and plays `length` frames of the file
from `fileOffset`, at `gainDb`, with fades of `fadeIn` and `fadeOut` frames whose curves run
from −1 (slow start, exponential-looking) through 0 (linear) to 1 (fast start, logarithmic-looking): a fade-in's
gain at position x (0…1) is x^(2^(−2c)), a fade-out the mirror. A muted region
does not play. Two regions on a track may overlap only as a crossfade: where the earlier fades out and the later
fades in.

AutomationLane.description:
Track automation of one parameter. `trackId` null is the master strip. `target` is `volume` (dB),
`pan` (−1…1), `mute` (0/1), `send:{sendId}` (dB), `insert:{insertId}:{parameterId}` or
`instrument:{parameterId}` (the parameter's unit). Phase 6 adds `midiEffect:{slotId}:{parameterId}` (a
MIDI FX slot's parameter) and `smartControl:{controlId}` (0…1; it compiles to automation of every
parameter the control maps). Points are sorted by tick.

AutomationPoint.description: A point of an automation lane, in the target's own unit; `curve` −1…1 shapes the segment to the next.

BeatMapping.description:
Beat mapping: tick `tick` lands on project sample `sample` (the tempo events are set so that it does,
keeping earlier mappings and the positions before them).

Bookmarks.description: Folders pinned in the All Files browser.

BounceInPlaceRequest.description:
Bounce in place: tracks (`trackIds`, their whole range) or regions (`regionIds`, theirs) rendered
isolated by the host through `render`, through their inserts unless `bypassEffects`, with fader and pan
only when `includeVolumePan`, plus the effects' tail when `includeTail`; normalised as a bounce. When
the job finishes, the server adds the files and, in one undo step, adds a new track (or replaces the regions) and
leaves, mutes or deletes the source. `name` names the new track or regions (left out: the source's, plus
" Bounce").

BounceRequest.description:
Bounce (export): the range (ticks; left out: the cycle when it is on, else the project start to its end), the
source, and the file: format, bit depth (16, 24, or 32 for float), sample rate (left out: the project's), dither
(applied below 32 bits), normalisation. `realtime` plays the bounce through the device instead of rendering
offline; `addToProject` adds the result to the project's audio files.

Cell.description:
A Live Loops cell: at most one per (track, scene). `lengthTicks` is its loop length; `quantize`
overrides the grid's for launching it (null: the grid's).

CellContent.description:
What a cell plays: exactly one of a snapshot of an audio region, a MIDI region or a pattern region, the one of
its `kind`. The snapshot's `id` is the cell's, its `trackId` the cell's track and its
`startTick` 0; note and controller ids are unique project-wide, as in any MIDI region.

ChannelStrip.description:
A channel strip: volume in dB (−∞ as −144), pan −1 (left) … 1 (right), mute and solo; its insert effects in
order; its sends to buses; where it goes (`output`: `master`, `bus:N` for bus 1…64, or
`output:N` for the device's stereo output pair N); the mixer groups it belongs to (1…32); and the VCA track
that offsets its volume, if any. The master strip uses only volume, pan, mute and its inserts. Phase 6:
`midiEffects` are its MIDI FX slots (instrument and external MIDI tracks only; empty elsewhere), in the
same shape as inserts: they run in slot order on the block's MIDI (regions, live and step input) before the
instrument; bypassed slots pass it through.

CommandBatch.description: Edits applied as one undo step; `label` names it in the undo history ("Move Region").

CommandResult.description: What an edit, undo or redo did: the new revision and the delta every client receives too.

CompSegment.description: Part of a comp: take `takeId` plays from `startTick` to `endTick`.

ControlEvent.description:
A controller event of a MIDI region; `tick` is relative to the region's start. `id` is unique in the
project. `number` is the controller of a control change and the key of a poly pressure event, 0 for the
other kinds. Together with the notes these are every event the Event List shows (Phase 7).

ControlEventChange.description:
Changes to one controller event (Phase 7, the Event List; `setControls`); left-out properties stay. Its kind
stays: to change it, delete the event and add another. Values are checked against the kind's range.

DeltaOpArticulationSetUpserted.description: Phase 7: an articulation set was added or changed.

DeltaOpGrooveUpserted.description: Phase 7: a groove template was added or changed.

DeltaOpLaneSetUpserted.description: Phase 7: a Step Editor lane set was added or changed.

DeltaOpLiveLoopsChanged.description: The Live Loops grid changed: its scenes, cells, quantise or visibility (the whole grid).

DeltaOpMidiRegionUpserted.description: A MIDI region was added or changed (its notes included).

DeltaOpPatternRegionUpserted.description: A pattern region was added or changed (its pattern included).

DeltaOpTrackUpserted.description: A track was added or changed; `index` is its position in the track list.

DirectoryListing.description: A folder's entries, folders first; `parent` is null at a root.

DrumMachine.description:
A Drum Machine Designer (docs/07-phase-6.md): the track is a stack whose members are its pads, each an instrument
track with its own channel strip; `pads` (at most one per note, sorted by note) map a note to a pad. The
DMD track's region and pattern notes are routed to the pad tracks by note (live MIDI too, by the host), their
note numbers unchanged: a pad plays its own sound whatever the note (the Drum Synth ignores pitch; a Quick
Sampler pad has key follow off and plays at its root).

DrumPad.description: A pad of a Drum Machine Designer: note `note` (0…127) plays sub-track `trackId`.

EditCommand.description:
An edit of the open project (docs/adr/0004-state-ownership.md). A batch of them is applied atomically as one
undo step. Optional properties left out are left unchanged.

EditCommandAdaptTempoCommand.description:
Sets the project's tempo events from an audio region's file tempo (analysed now if need be) over the region's
range, and makes the region play unwarped there.

EditCommandAddAuxCommand.description: Adds an aux track listening to bus `bus` (the lowest unused bus when left out).

EditCommandAddControlsCommand.description: Adds controller events (Phase 7: of every ControlKind, poly pressure included).

EditCommandAddDrumPadCommand.description:
Adds a pad on note `note` (0…127, free on this DMD) to a DMD track: a new member instrument track playing
`pluginId` (left out: the Drum Synth, `anode.drum-synth`), named `name`.

EditCommandAddInsertCommand.description:
Adds an insert effect at `index` (the end when left out); the master's when `trackId` is left out. With
`chain``midiEffects`, a MIDI FX slot instead, as for every insert command.

EditCommandAddMidiRegionCommand.description: Adds an empty MIDI region to an instrument or external MIDI track.

EditCommandAddPatternRegionCommand.description:
Adds a pattern region to an instrument track: `lengthTicks` (left out: one bar at `startTick`'s
signature) and `pattern` (left out: the default pattern: on a Drum Machine Designer track one pad row per
pad, else one note row on C3 (60); each 16 steps of a 16th, all off, no swing).

EditCommandAddRegionCommand.description: Places a file on a track; the whole file unless `fileOffset` and `length` say otherwise.

EditCommandAddSceneCommand.description: Adds an empty scene to the Live Loops grid at `index` (the end when left out).

EditCommandAddSectionCommand.description: Adds an arrangement section; it must not overlap another.

EditCommandAddSendCommand.description: Adds a send to bus 1…64 (post-fader at −∞ dB unless told otherwise, as Logic does).

EditCommandAddTrackCommand.description:
Adds a track at `index` (the end when left out): audio by default; an instrument track gets
`pluginId` (the default synth when left out).

EditCommandApplyPatchCommand.description: Replaces a track's instrument, inserts and sends with a saved patch's.

EditCommandAssignArticulationSetCommand.description: Phase 7: gives an instrument or external MIDI track an articulation set of the project (null: none).

EditCommandAssignVcaCommand.description: Assigns a track to a VCA track, or removes it from its VCA (null).

EditCommandAutoMapSmartControlsCommand.description:
Automatic mapping: replaces the knobs' names and mappings with the plugins' macro hints in order (the
instrument's, then each insert's), up to the layout's knobs; each knob takes its parameter's current value.

EditCommandCompareSmartControlsCommand.description:
Compare: on, the controls show (and their parameters take) their saved values; off, the edited ones again. The
server applies it without an undo step (its delta still reaches every client).

EditCommandConvertPatternToMidiCommand.description:
Replaces a pattern region with a MIDI region of exactly the notes it plays over its length (one pass of the
region), at the same place, with its name and mute.

EditCommandCopyRegionsCommand.description:
Copies regions (of any kind) `offsetTicks` later (or earlier), onto `trackId` when given (⌥-drag,
repeat).

EditCommandCreateDrumMachineCommand.description:
Makes a Drum Machine Designer: a new DMD stack at the end, or, with `trackId`, an instrument track turned
into one in place (its regions and pattern regions stay on the DMD track, its instrument goes). The pads come
from kit patch `kitPatchId` (left out: no pads).

EditCommandCreateStackCommand.description: Puts tracks into a new folder stack, inserted where the first of them was.

EditCommandDeleteArticulationSetCommand.description: Phase 7: removes an articulation set; tracks that used it have none (their notes keep their ids).

EditCommandDeleteGrooveCommand.description: Phase 7: removes a groove template; regions whose playback quantise used it return to the grid.

EditCommandDeleteGroupCommand.description: Deletes a mixer group; its members leave it.

EditCommandDeleteSectionsCommand.description:
Deletes sections. With `removeContent`, also everything that starts in them, and later material closes the
gap (Logic's "delete the section and its content").

EditCommandDeleteTakeCommand.description: Removes a take (and its comp segments) from a folder; the folder's last take cannot be removed.

EditCommandDeleteTrackAlternativeCommand.description: Deletes a track alternative with its content; deleting the active one selects another first.

EditCommandFlattenTakeFolderCommand.description: Replaces a take folder with regions playing its comp, crossfaded at the boundaries.

EditCommandFlexPitchToMidiCommand.description:
Makes a MIDI region of an audio region's pitch notes (their target pitches, at the times they play) on
`trackId`, or on a new instrument track under the region's when left out.

EditCommandJoinRegionsCommand.description:
Glues regions of one track into one: MIDI regions merge their notes; audio regions only when they play one
contiguous stretch of the same file (others need a bounce, Phase 4), else 422.

EditCommandLoadInsertFileCommand.description:
Loads a file into an insert (the master's when `trackId` is left out): an impulse response into the
convolution reverb (`anode.space`), a path on the server's disk of one of the plugin's `fileTypes`. A
file outside the project is copied into its `Impulse Responses` folder; the insert keeps it relative.

EditCommandLoadInstrumentFileCommand.description: Loads a file (a sampler instrument, a sample) into a track's instrument; a path on the server's disk.

EditCommandMakeGrooveCommand.description:
Phase 7: Make Groove Template: adds to the project's grooves a template made from a MIDI region (its notes) or an
audio region (its file's transients), over its first `lengthBars` bars (1…4; left out: 1), with grid
steps of `stepTicks` (left out: a 1/16, 240), named `name` (left out: the region's).

EditCommandMapBeatsCommand.description:
Beat mapping: for each mapping in order, sets tempo events so that its tick lands on its sample, keeping earlier
mappings and the positions before them.

EditCommandMoveCellCommand.description:
Moves (or with `copy`, copies) a cell to the slot of `trackId` and `sceneId`, replacing the cell
there; the track must suit its content.

EditCommandMoveInsertCommand.description: Moves an insert to another slot of the same strip (and chain).

EditCommandMoveSectionCommand.description:
Moves (or with `copy`, copies) a section and everything that starts in it to `toTick`, which must be a
section boundary or the end of the last section: the section is inserted there and the material after it moves
later by its length; a move then closes the gap it left. Regions, take folders and markers move with it.

EditCommandNewTrackAlternativeCommand.description:
Makes a new track alternative and selects it: empty, or a copy of the active one when `duplicate` (with new
ids). The track's first alternative also names the current content.

EditCommandPackTakeFolderCommand.description: Packs overlapping or adjacent audio regions of one track into a new take folder, one take each.

EditCommandQuantizeAudioCommand.description:
Quantises audio regions: flex markers on their transients (analysed now if need be) move toward the grid of
`gridTicks` by `strength` (0…1), with `swing` (0…1) delaying every second grid step. Turns flex
on for their tracks when it is off. Phase 7: `grooveId` and a matching groove track as for
QuantizeNotesCommand (audio has no velocities, so no `grooveVelocity`).

EditCommandQuantizeNotesCommand.description:
Moves note starts towards the grid (destructive; `noteIds` left out: every note of the region), with the
same strength and swing meaning as RegionPlayback. Phase 7: with `grooveId` (a groove
template of the project), towards the template's positions instead (`gridTicks` and `swing` unused),
and with `grooveVelocity` true the velocities follow its scales by the same strength. On a track whose
`matchGroove` is on, a quantise without `grooveId` uses the groove track's groove, extracted from its
first region at the time of the quantise.

EditCommandRemoveDrumPadCommand.description: Removes the pad on note `note` of a DMD track, with its track.

EditCommandRemoveSceneCommand.description: Removes a scene and its cells.

EditCommandRemoveStackCommand.description: Removes a folder stack; its tracks stay, outside any stack.

EditCommandReseedPatternCommand.description: Sets a pattern's seed (left out: a new one the server draws), so chance and random steps draw anew.

EditCommandResizeMidiRegionCommand.description:
Moves a MIDI region's start and end. Its notes stay where they are in time: moving the start shifts their
relative positions, and notes that fall outside are kept but do not play.

EditCommandResizeRegionCommand.description: Trims a region: its new start, and the part of the file it plays.

EditCommandSelectTakeCommand.description: Makes one take the whole comp.

EditCommandSelectTrackAlternativeCommand.description: Swaps a track's live regions, MIDI regions and take folders for those of alternative `alternativeId`.

EditCommandSetArticulationSetCommand.description:
Phase 7: adds an articulation set to the project (one from the library) or replaces the one with its id.
Articulation ids 1…254 and unique; switches and outputs name articulations of the set, with values in their
ranges (ArticulationOutputKind).

EditCommandSetAutomationCommand.description: Replaces one automation lane's points (an empty list removes the lane); the master's when no track.

EditCommandSetCellCommand.description:
Creates or changes the cell of `trackId` and `sceneId`. `content` creates it or replaces what it
plays (its kind follows; it must suit the track: audio on an audio track, MIDI or pattern on an instrument
track; ids as CellContent says, the server renumbering what clashes); a cell that does not exist
needs it. `quantize` sets its own launch quantise; `gridQuantize` true clears it, so it follows the
grid's.

EditCommandSetCompCommand.description: Replaces a take folder's comp (Quick Swipe Comping sends the whole comp after each swipe).

EditCommandSetControlsCommand.description:
Phase 7, the Event List: changes controller events of a region (tick, channel, number, value; checked as
`addControls` checks them).

EditCommandSetDrumPadCommand.description:
Changes the pad on note `note` of a DMD track: renames it (and its track), gives its track another
instrument (`pluginId`, parameters at their defaults), or moves it to free note `toNote`. Its channel
strip is edited through the pad track's own strip and insert commands.

EditCommandSetFileTempoCommand.description: Sets a file's tempo, beats and downbeats (the Smart Tempo Editor), or clears them (null).

EditCommandSetFileVersionCommand.description:
Phase 7, the Audio File Editor: points a file at another version of itself: `path` (relative to the
project, the `<name>.vN.wav` an `audioEdit` job wrote) as `version`, with its frame count
and rate when an operation changed them. The job applies it when it finishes (with the region shifts a length
change needs, in the same undo step); undo applies it back. Clients do not send it.

EditCommandSetFlexMarkersCommand.description:
Replaces an audio region's flex markers: file frames inside the region, their ticks increasing with them and
inside the region. Needs the track's flex on.

EditCommandSetGrooveCommand.description:
Phase 7: adds a groove template to the project (one from the library) or replaces the one with its id (a
rename); `points` must hold lengthTicks ÷ stepTicks points.

EditCommandSetGrooveTrackCommand.description: Phase 7: makes a track (with regions: MIDI or audio) the groove track, or none when null.

EditCommandSetInsertCommand.description:
Bypasses an insert, or sets its sidechain (a track id, `bus:N`, or an empty string for none; never on a MIDI
FX slot).

EditCommandSetInsertParameterCommand.description: Sets one insert parameter; coalesces like `setParameter`, and records automation like `setStrip`.

EditCommandSetInstrumentCommand.description: Replaces an instrument track's instrument; its parameters start at their defaults.

EditCommandSetKeysCommand.description: Replaces the key track; the first event at tick 0.

EditCommandSetLaneSetCommand.description: Phase 7: adds a Step Editor lane set to the project or replaces the one with its id.

EditCommandSetLiveLoopsCommand.description: Sets the Live Loops grid's launch quantise, or shows or hides it.

EditCommandSetMatchGrooveCommand.description: Phase 7: a track's "match groove track": its quantise follows the groove track.

EditCommandSetMidiRegionCommand.description:
Changes a MIDI region's name, mute or playback parameters. `grooveId` (Phase 7) makes its playback quantise
follow a groove template of the project; an empty string returns it to the grid.

EditCommandSetOutputCommand.description: Routes a track to `master`, `bus:N` or `output:N`; a route that would make a loop is refused.

EditCommandSetParameterCommand.description:
Sets one parameter of a track's instrument. Consecutive batches on the same parameter within 1 s coalesce into
one undo step, as `setStrip` does.

EditCommandSetPatternCommand.description:
Replaces a pattern region's whole pattern (every Step Sequencer edit sends it). Rows: unique ids, length 1…64
with as many steps, step values in their ranges (PatternStep); swing 0…1; else 422.

EditCommandSetPatternRegionCommand.description:
Moves (in time), resizes, renames or mutes a pattern region; `moveRegion`, `copyRegions` and
`deleteRegions` take pattern regions too.

EditCommandSetPitchNotesCommand.description:
Replaces an audio region's Flex Pitch notes (edits, splits and joins); notes need Flex or Follow, as a
transpose does.

EditCommandSetRegionFlexCommand.description:
Sets an audio region's Flex & Follow, transpose (semitones) or fine tune (cents). A transpose or fine tune
needs Flex or Follow (the track's flex on, or a `follow` other than `off`), else 422.

EditCommandSetSceneCommand.description: Renames a scene, or moves it to `index`.

EditCommandSetScriptCommand.description:
Phase 7, Scripter: sets the script of MIDI FX slot `slotId` (an `anode.scripter` slot) of a track.
The host compiles it and reports its parameters (`Insert.runtimeParameters`); a script that fails to
compile is bypassed with a `pluginProblem`, and the slot keeps the source.

EditCommandSetSectionCommand.description: Renames, recolours or resizes a section (from its end); it must not come to overlap another.

EditCommandSetSendCommand.description: Changes a send; coalesces and records automation like `setStrip`.

EditCommandSetSignatureCommand.description: Sets the signature at the project start (the first signature event), keeping later changes.

EditCommandSetSignaturesCommand.description: Replaces the signature track; the first event at tick 0, each later one on a bar line.

EditCommandSetSmartControlCommand.description:
Sets a Smart Control's value (0…1; applying every mapping's parameter, coalesced as `setParameter`, and
recording automation of `smartControl:{controlId}` as `setStrip` records volume) or renames it.

EditCommandSetSmartControlsCommand.description:
Sets a track's Smart Controls layout (controls a smaller layout drops lose their mappings) or turns its
arpeggiator button on or off (adding, bypassing or unbypassing `anode.arpeggiator` in its first MIDI FX
slot). Sets the Smart Controls up when they are null.

EditCommandSetSmartMappingsCommand.description: Replaces a Smart Control's mappings (targets that exist on the track; graphs as SmartMapping).

EditCommandSetSmartTempoCommand.description: Sets the project tempo mode, the follow new audio regions get, or whether imports are analysed.

EditCommandSetStripCommand.description:
Changes a track's volume, pan, mute or solo, or the master's when `trackId` is left out. Members of the
track's enabled mixer groups that link the property follow it (volume keeps their offsets). During playback, a
track whose automation mode is touch, latch or write records the change into its lane (and the batch coalesces as
a drag does).

EditCommandSetTempoCommand.description: Sets the tempo at the project start (the first tempo event), keeping the rest of the tempo track.

EditCommandSetTempoEventsCommand.description: Replaces the tempo track; the first event must be at tick 0. Audio regions keep their musical positions.

EditCommandSetTrackActivationCommand.description: Track activation: the tracks play their Live Loops cells (on) or their Tracks-area regions (off).

EditCommandSetTrackFlexCommand.description: Turns a track's flex on or off, or changes its algorithm.

EditCommandSetTrackParentCommand.description: Moves a track into a stack (`parentId`) or out of one (null). Stacks do not nest.

EditCommandSetVarispeedCommand.description: Turns Varispeed on or off, or sets its mode or speed (0.5…1.5).

EditCommandSplitRegionCommand.description: Splits a region in two at `atTick`, which must fall inside it.

EditCommandStepNotesCommand.description:
Phase 7, step input: adds a step of notes (one per pitch, a chord when several) at the step position. Clients
(and MIDI step input) send only `pitches`, and `velocity` to override the state's; the server fills
every left-out property from the step input state (StepInputState) before it applies the command
(a new region on `trackId` when `regionId` is left out there too), then advances the position unless
chord mode is on. `positionTick` is a project tick; `lengthTicks` the step's length; `channel`
1 unless given.

EditCommandStepTieCommand.description:
Phase 7, step input: a tie lengthens the last step's notes (`noteIds`; the server fills them in) by one step
(`lengthTicks`; filled in from the state), and advances the position. A rest is not an edit:
`POST /project/step-input/rest`.

EditCommandStripSilenceCommand.description:
Strip Silence: splits each audio region into one region per stretch above `thresholdDb` (RMS), each widened
by `preAttackMs` before and `postReleaseMs` after; the silence between them is removed. As in Logic,
`minTimeMs` is the shortest silence that splits: stretches separated by less stay in one region.

EditCommandTransformCommand.description:
Phase 7, MIDI Transform: applies `set` (mode `operateOnly` or `selectAndOperate`;
`selectOnly` is the editor's own, and refused) to the events of MIDI regions `regionIds`: when
`noteIds` or `controlIds` is given, to those events only (the editor's selection), else to every
event of the regions. Positions are project ticks while it runs, so position conditions and crescendos span
the regions. One undo step, through `TransformEngine.Apply`.

EditCommandUnfreezeTrackCommand.description: Plays a frozen track live again (its freeze file stays in the project's audio).

EngineStatus.description:
The server's link to the engine host: whether it is reachable (`state`), the host's version and audio
backend (`coreaudio`, `wasapi`, `alsa`, `null`) from its hello while connected, and why the
link is down when it is (`message`).

FileAnalysis.description:
A file's analysis, cached in the package as `Analysis/<fileId>.json` and rebuilt on demand: its
transients (file frames), its tempo (null until beats are tracked), its pitch curve (MIDI cents per
`hop` frames from frame 0; null where unvoiced; empty until pitch is analysed), its notes, and whether
it sounds polyphonic (Flex Pitch then works less well).

FileEntry.description:
An entry of a folder on the server's disk. Audio files carry their format when it could be read
(`sampleRate`, `channels`, `frames`).

FileTempo.description:
A file's tempo (Smart Tempo): its average tempo, whether it varies, and its beats and downbeats in file frames,
ascending.

FlexFollow.description: How an audio region follows the project tempo (Logic's Flex & Follow).

FlexMarker.description:
A flex marker: file frame `fileFrame` (absolute in the file) plays at `tick`, relative to the region's
`startTick`. Between neighbouring markers, and between the outermost markers and the region's ends, the
region's base map is scaled linearly; the region's start and end stay where the base map puts them.

FlexMode.description: A track's flex algorithm (docs/06-phase-5.md). A region is warped when its track's flex is on, its `follow` is not `off`, or it has a transpose or pitch notes; warped regions play through the track's algorithm (Polyphonic while flex is off).

GraphPoint.description: A point of a mapping graph: input `x` (0…1) gives output `y` (0…1).

GroovePoint.description:
One grid step of a groove template: where its onset lands (`tick`, from the template's start) and how its
velocity scales (1: unchanged; the strongest onset of the template is 1).

GrooveTemplate.description:
A groove template (docs/08-phase-7.md, "Grooves"): one point per grid step of `stepTicks` over
`lengthTicks` (1–4 bars), so `points` holds lengthTicks ÷ stepTicks points in step order, point n
being step n's onset (near n × stepTicks). Made from a MIDI region's notes or an audio region's transients: the
strongest onset per grid step (a step without one keeps its grid position at scale 1). Quantising to it moves a
note to the template position of its grid step (the template repeating every `lengthTicks` from the
project start), by the quantise's strength. Ids start with `grv_`; templates live in the project
(`Project.grooves`) and in the user library (`/library/grooves`).

GroupProperties.description: What a mixer group links among its members (Logic's group settings).

ImportFileRequest.description: Import an audio file the server can read from its own disk (the desktop app, a headless box's library).

Insert.description:
An insert effect on a channel strip: the plugin, whether it is bypassed, its parameter values by parameter id
(all of them), and its sidechain source (a track id or `bus:N`; null: none). A plugin's opaque state lives in
the project's `Plugin States` folder. A MIDI FX slot (`ChannelStrip.midiEffects`) has the same shape,
never a sidechain. Phase 6: `file` is the file the effect loads (an impulse response for
`anode.space`; `loadInsertFile`), relative to the project when it is inside it (null: none).
Phase 7 (docs/08-phase-7.md): `runtimeParameters` is the parameter list of a slot whose plugin defines its
parameters at run time (Scripter's `PluginParameters`; the host reports it after each compile, and the
server stores it here): `parameters` holds their values, and they automate
(`midiEffect:{slotId}:{parameterId}`) and map to Smart Controls as any parameter (null: the plugin's
catalogue list applies). `source` is a Scripter slot's script (`setScript`; null on every other
slot).

InstallPackRequest.description: Installs a `.anodepack` from the server's disk (replacing an installed version of the same pack).

InstrumentSlot.description:
A track's instrument: the plugin, its parameter values by parameter id (all of them), and the file it loaded
(a sampler's instrument), relative to the project folder when inside it. A plugin's opaque state lives in the
project's `Plugin States` folder.

IoLabel.description: A user name for an input, output pair or bus (Logic's I/O Labels).

Job.description: A long-running job; `progress` 0…1; `files` are what it wrote (absolute paths), when done.

KeyCommandSet.description: Key bindings by command id (`transport.play`); each binding like `Space` or `Meta+Shift+Z`.

KeyEvent.description: A key change; `tonic` is a pitch class 0 (C) … 11 (B). The first is at tick 0.

Lane.description:
A Step Editor lane: its kind, its controller or key (`number`: for `controlChange`,
`polyPressure` and `note`; null otherwise), its name, and the grid the pencil and line tools draw on
(`resolutionTicks` > 0).

LaneKind.description: What a Step Editor lane shows and draws.

LaneSet.description:
A saved set of Step Editor lanes (Logic's lane sets), in the project (`Project.laneSets`; ids
`lns_`). A project without any shows the default set: Velocity, Modulation (CC 1), Pitch Bend, Channel
Pressure and Program, each at a 1/16 (240 ticks); the first `setLaneSet` stores the set it edits.

LaunchRequest.description: Launches Live Loops cells, or a scene (its cells; tracks with no cell in it stop), each at its quantise boundary.

LiveLoopsGrid.description:
The Live Loops grid (docs/07-phase-6.md): its scenes in order, its cells, the launch quantise, and whether the
grid is shown beside the Tracks area. A track whose `liveLoopsActive` is on plays its playing cell instead
of its Tracks-area regions; launching a scene launches its cells and stops the cells of tracks with none in it.

LiveMidiEvent.description: One raw MIDI message (status 0x80…0xEF, data bytes 0…127).

LiveMidiRequest.description: Plays MIDI on a track now, as if it came from a keyboard (the on-screen keyboard, musical typing).

LiveRecordRequest.description:
Starts or stops recording in Live Loops: into the cell of `trackId` and `sceneId` (the track's input,
from the next quantise boundary, for the cell's length or until stopped); without them, a performance recording
(cells and Remix FX into the Tracks area, one undo step when it stops).

LoopFavouriteRequest.description: Marks a loop a favourite, or not.

LoopInfo.description:
A loop of the loop index (`<DataDirectory>/Library/Loops/index.json`, rebuilt from the installed
packs and the user's loops): its pack (null: a user loop), its file on the server's disk, its tempo (bpm) and
length in beats (null for a one-shot), its key (a tonic 0 (C) … 11 (B); null: none, as drums), scale and tags
(the keyword buttons: Drums, Bass …), whether it is a one-shot, and whether the user marked it a favourite.

LoopKind.description: What a tagged loop holds, and what adding it to a project makes.

LoopPage.description: A page of a loop search, and how many loops match in all.

LoopScale.description: The scale a loop suits, for the Loop Browser's scale filter.

LoopSearchRequest.description:
Loop search over frames `startFrame`…`endFrame` of a file's current version: the `count` best
loops (1…20; left out: 5) at least `minFrames` long (left out: 10 ms).

LoopSearchResult.description:
A loop found by loop search: frames `startFrame`…`endFrame` (exclusive), and how seamlessly it
repeats (`score` 0…1, 1 best). Results come best first.

Marker.description: A marker: a named position, with an optional length, colour and text (Logic's Marker List).

MetronomeSettings.description: The click: on or off, a one-bar count-in before recording, and its level in dB.

MidiInputSettings.description: Where a track takes live MIDI from: a device id (null: every device) and channel (0: all, else 1…16).

MidiOutputSettings.description: Where an external MIDI track sends its regions: a device id and channel 1…16.

MidiPort.description: A MIDI port of the machine the engine runs on.

MidiRegion.description:
A MIDI region: it starts at `startTick` and lasts `lengthTicks`; its notes and controller events are
positioned relative to its start (ticks at 960 PPQ). Events past the end do not play; a note that crosses the end
is cut there. `playback` holds the non-destructive region parameters.

MidiThruRequest.description:
Which track hears live MIDI when no instrument track is record-armed (Logic sends input to the selected
track); null: none.

MixerGroup.description: A mixer group 1…32; tracks join it through their strip's `groups`.

MixerSettings.description:
Plugin delay compensation, and low-latency mode: while it is on, plugins on the path of record-armed or
monitored tracks whose latency exceeds `lowLatencyLimitMs` are bypassed.

NewControlEvent.description: A controller event to add; `tick` relative to the region's start.

NewNote.description: A note to add; positions relative to the region's start; `articulationId` left out: 0 (none).

Note.description:
A note. `id` is unique in the project; `channel` is 1…16. `articulationId` (Phase 7) is its
articulation in its track's articulation set (1…254; 0: none): the articulation's outputs play just before the
note, at its tick, on its channel (a channel output changes the note's channel instead).

NoteChange.description: Changes to one note; left-out properties stay. `articulationId` 0 clears its articulation.

Pack.description:
A content pack (`.anodepack`: a zip of loops, patches, kits and IRs with a `pack.json` manifest),
installed under `<DataDirectory>/Library/Packs/<id>/`. `size` is in bytes.

ParameterInfo.description:
A plugin parameter. `steps` > 0 makes it discrete (`steps` + 1 values from `min` to
`max`), with `valueNames` naming them when it is a choice. `macro` (Phase 6) is its macro hint:
automatic Smart Controls mapping takes a plugin's hinted parameters in ascending `macro` order (null: not a
macro).

PatchInfo.description: A saved channel strip (Logic's patch): its instrument, inserts and sends, for a kind of track.

PatternPlayMode.description: The order a pattern row walks its steps in, each pass.

PatternRegion.description:
A pattern region on an instrument track: it plays `pattern` from `startTick` for
`lengthTicks`, every row cycling from the region's start.

PatternRow.description:
A row of a pattern: what it plays (`kind` and `note`), its name, its length in steps (1…64; it cycles
independently of other rows' lengths), its step length in ticks (`stepTicks`; null: the pattern's), its
play mode, and whether it is muted. `steps` always has exactly `length` entries.

PatternRowKind.description: What a pattern row plays (docs/07-phase-6.md, "Pattern regions").

PatternStep.description:
One step of a pattern row. `velocity` 1…127; `gate` is the note's length in steps, 0…16 (exclusive of
0; 1 is the whole step, over 1 holds into the next steps, a tie); `repeats` 1…8 split the gate evenly into
that many notes (ratchets); `chance` 0…1 is the probability the step plays on a pass; `offset` −0.5…0.5
moves it by that fraction of a step. An off step plays nothing but keeps its values.

PitchNote.description:
A Flex Pitch note of a region, over file frames `startFrame`…`endFrame`. Pitches are MIDI cents (6900
is A4): the analysed `detectedCents` plays as `targetCents`. `drift` and `vibrato` scale the
analysed drift and vibrato around the note's own trend (1 unchanged, 0 removed, up to 2); `formantCents`
shifts the formants, `gainDb` the level.

PitchSegment.description: A stable voiced run of a file's pitch curve, in file frames, at `cents` (MIDI cents).

PluginEditorRequest.description: Opens (or closes) a plugin's own editor window: an insert, or with no `insertId` the instrument.

PluginInfo.description:
A plugin the engine can load: an instrument (`category``Instrument`), a MIDI effect (`MIDI
Effect`, Phase 6: it goes in a strip's MIDI FX slots), or an effect in `category` (EQ, Dynamics, Delay,
Reverb, Modulation, Distortion, Filter, Utility, Metering). `hasEditor`: it has its own editor window (desktop app
only; everywhere else the generic editor). `fileTypes` (extensions such as `.sfz`, `.wav`) lists
what an
instrument loads with `loadInstrumentFile`, empty when it loads none.

PreviewRangeRequest.description:
Plays frames `startFrame`…`endFrame` of a file's current version through the preview channel
(`/project/files/{fileId}/preview`), looping when `loop`; `POST /files/preview` with a null path
stops it.

PreviewRequest.description: Plays a file through the engine's preview channel (null stops it).

ProcessEffect.description: A built-in effect of a processing chain, with the parameters it is set to (the rest at their defaults).

ProcessRequest.description:
Selection-based processing: runs `chain` (built-in effects only, in order) in-process over the regions'
audio between `startTick` and `endTick` (left out: the regions' own ends), with the chain's tail when
`includeTail`. When the job finishes, the server writes a new file per region and, in one undo step,
replaces that part of each region with a new region of it.

Project.description:
The open project (docs/01-implementation-plan.md §5). Musical positions are ticks at 960 PPQ; audio offsets,
lengths and fades are frames at the project's `sampleRate`. `revision` grows with every edit and is
the ETag; `dirty` says whether it has unsaved edits. Phase 6 (docs/07-phase-6.md): `patternRegions`
are the Step Sequencer's regions; `liveLoops` is the Live Loops grid. Phase 7 (docs/08-phase-7.md):
`grooves` are the project's groove templates, `articulationSets` its articulation sets and
`laneSets` its Step Editor lane sets.

ProjectAlternative.description: A saved alternative of the open project (Logic's project alternatives); one is current.

ProjectBackup.description: An automatic backup, made at each save of the current alternative (the newest ten are kept).

ProjectDelta.description:
What changed between two revisions of the open project (docs/adr/0004-state-ownership.md). Clients apply the
operations in order; a client that misses a revision refetches the project.

ProjectSettings.description:
Global settings. `tempo` and `signature` are the values at the project start (the first of
`tempoEvents` and `signatures`, which are the global tempo and signature tracks).
`endTick` is the project end marker. `mergeMidiRecording`: a MIDI recording over an
existing MIDI region adds its notes to that region instead of making a new one. `smartTempo` and
`varispeed` (Phase 5): the project tempo mode and Varispeed. `grooveTrackId` (Phase 7) is the groove
track (null: none): tracks whose `matchGroove` is on quantise to the groove of its first region.

ProjectSummary.description: A project in the recent list.

ProjectTempoMode.description: What an audio import or recording does to the project tempo (Logic's project tempo modes).

RecordingSettings.description:
How recording works: cycle recording mode; replace mode (a recording removes what it covers on its track); and
autopunch, which records only between `punchInTick` and `punchOutTick` while playback continues around
them.

RegionPlayback.description:
How a MIDI region plays, without changing its notes (Logic's Region inspector): transpose in semitones,
velocity offset (−127…127), quantise grid in ticks (0: off) with strength (0…1, 1 = all the way) and swing
(0…1, 0 = straight; delays every second grid step by up to half a step). `grooveId` (Phase 7): it
quantises to that groove template of the project instead of the grid (`quantizeTicks` and `swing`
then unused; null: the grid).

SampleRange.description:
Samples of a file's current version for the Audio File Editor (`/project/files/{fileId}/samples`):
`frames` frames from `startFrame`, in buckets of `bucket` frames. With `bucket` 1,
`samples` holds each channel's samples and `min` and `max` are null; with a larger bucket,
`min` and `max` hold each channel's extremes per bucket (the last bucket may be short) and
`samples` is null.

Scene.description: A row of the Live Loops grid.

Screenset.description:
A saved layout of the editor's windows (Logic's screensets), recalled with keys 1–9. `layout` is the
editor's own serialised layout, opaque to the server.

Send.description: A send from a channel strip to bus 1…64, at `levelDb`, before or after the fader.

SignatureEvent.description: A time signature change, on a bar line of the signature before it. The first is at tick 0.

SmartControl.description:
A Smart Control: its id (`knob1`…`knob12`, `switch1`, `switch2`, `padX`, `padY`),
name, kind, value (0…1) and mappings (any number). `savedValue` is the other side of Compare: while not
comparing, the value the project was last saved with (null: unchanged since); while comparing, the edited value
that Compare will restore.

SmartControls.description:
A track's Smart Controls (docs/07-phase-6.md): the layout and its controls in order (knobs, then
`switch1`, `switch2`, then `padX`, `padY`: every control of the layout); the arpeggiator
button (null on a track without MIDI FX; on, the track's first MIDI FX slot is an unbypassed
`anode.arpeggiator`); and whether Compare shows the saved values.

SmartMapping.description:
A Smart Control's mapping to one parameter. `target` addresses it as automation lanes do (`volume`,
`pan`, `send:{sendId}`, `instrument:{parameterId}`, `insert:{insertId}:{parameterId}`,
`midiEffect:{slotId}:{parameterId}`; see AutomationLane). The control's value goes through
`graph` (piecewise linear, 2–16 points sorted by x, the first at x 0 and the last at x 1; the default is
the line (0, 0)–(1, 1)), is inverted (1 − y) when `invert`, then scaled to `min` … `max` in the
parameter's unit.

SmartTempoSettings.description:
Smart Tempo: the project tempo mode, the `follow` new audio regions get, and whether imports are analysed
(transients and beats) as they arrive.

StepInputRequest.description:
Changes the step input state (`PUT /project/step-input`); left-out properties stay. `regionId` empty
clears it (steps then make a region on `trackId`).

StepInputState.description:
Step input (docs/08-phase-7.md, "Step input"), held by the server outside the project: it is not saved and not
undoable. While `on`, steps go into MIDI region `regionId`, or, when it is null, into a new region
the first step makes on instrument or external MIDI track `trackId` (from the step position, a bar long,
lengthened as steps pass its end). `positionTick` is the next step's project tick. A step lasts
`noteValueTicks` (a 1/16 is 240), × 1.5 when `dotted`, × 2/3 when `triplet`, at velocity
`velocity` (1…127). With `chord` on, steps stack at the position without advancing; turning it off
advances by one step when notes were stacked. `midiInput`: the host forwards the MIDI keyboard's notes as
steps (held keys make a chord). Changes reach every client as `stepInput` events on `/ws`.

StopRequest.description: Stops the cells playing on `trackIds` (left out: every track) at the grid's quantise boundary.

SystemInfo.description: What `GET /api/v1/system` answers: the server's version and its link to the engine host.

Take.description: A take: `length` frames of a file from `fileOffset`, starting at `startTick`.

TakeFolder.description:
A take folder: the takes of a cycle recording (or regions packed together) at one place on an audio track. Only
the comp plays: each segment plays its take from `startTick` to `endTick`, with `crossfade`
frames of crossfade at every boundary between segments. An empty comp plays nothing.

TempoEvent.description:
A point of the tempo track. The first is at tick 0. A ramp's tempo at fraction x (0…1) of the way to the next
event is bpm₀ + (bpm₁ − bpm₀)·x^(2^(−2·`shape`)), the fade formula: `shape` −1…1, 0 the linear ramp.

Track.description:
A track and its channel strip. `color` is a CSS colour; `input` is where an audio track records from.
An instrument track has an `instrument`; instrument and external MIDI tracks take MIDI from
`midiInput`, and an external MIDI track sends its regions to `midiOutput`. Phase 5: `flexOn` and
`flexMode` are its flex algorithm; `alternatives` are its inactive track alternatives, and
`alternativeId` names the active one (null until the track has alternatives). Phase 6: a Drum Machine
Designer stack has a `drumMachine` (null on every other track); `smartControls` are its Smart Controls
(null until set up: the editor shows the 8-knob layout, unnamed, at 0 and unmapped, and the first Smart Controls
command sets them up); `liveLoopsActive`: the track plays its Live Loops cells, not its Tracks-area
regions. Phase 7: `matchGroove`: its quantise follows the groove track (`settings.grooveTrackId`);
`articulationSetId` is its articulation set (null: none).

TrackAlternative.description:
An inactive alternative of a track: a snapshot of its regions, MIDI regions and take folders. The track's live
ones are its active alternative (`alternativeId`); selecting another swaps them in one undoable step, and
ids stay unique project-wide.

TrackInput.description: The device input: 1-based first channel (0: none); a stereo input takes that channel and the next.

TransformCondition.description:
A condition on one field of an event. A set's conditions are ANDed; a field without a condition (or with
`all`) matches everything. `b` is used by `inside` and `outside` only.

TransformConditionOp.description: How a condition compares its field with `a` (and `b`); `all` matches every event.

TransformField.description:
What a Transform condition tests or an operation changes (Logic's MIDI Transform window; docs/08-phase-7.md).
For a note: its position (project ticks), length (ticks), channel (1…16), pitch (0…127) and velocity (1…127).
For a controller event, as in Logic: `pitch` is its first data byte (a control change's controller, a poly
pressure's key; 0 otherwise) and `velocity` its value (a pitch bend's −8192…8191); its length is 0.
`status` is the event's MIDI status (the status byte's high nibble as a number: 144 note, 160 poly
pressure, 176 control change, 192 program change, 208 channel pressure, 224 pitch bend) and
`subposition` its position within its bar (ticks from the bar line); both are conditions only.

TransformOperation.description:
An operation on one field (`position`, `length`, `channel`, `pitch` or `velocity`; not
`status` or `subposition`). A set's operations apply to each selected event in field order: position,
length, channel, pitch, velocity, whatever their order in the list; at most one per field.

TransformOperationKind.description:
What an operation does to its field (value x, result clamped to the field's range and rounded to an integer).
`thru` leaves it; `fix` sets a; `add`/`subtract` x ± a; `min` max(x, a) (raises to at
least a); `max` min(x, a) (lowers to at most a); `flip` mirrors x around a (2a − x); `multiply`/
`divide` x × a, x ÷ a; `scale` x × a + b; `range` clamps to a…b; `random` a uniform value in
a…b; `plusMinusRandom` x plus a uniform value in −a…a; `quantize` to the nearest multiple of a;
`exponent` curves x over its range by exponent a (the field's range normalised to 0…1, raised to a, scaled
back); `crescendo` runs linearly from a at the first selected event's position to b at the last's;
`relativeCrescendo` adds that ramp to x; `useMap` looks x (0…127) up in the set's `map`.

TransformSet.description:
A MIDI Transform set: conditions (ANDed), operations, the 128-step `map` that `useMap` reads (128
values 0…127; null: the identity), the mode, and the seed of its random operations: each event draws from a
generator seeded by `seed` and the event's id, so applying a set is deterministic. Factory presets are
sets whose ids start with `factory.` (`factory.humanize`, `factory.quantize` …;
`TransformEngine.Presets`); the user's are saved in the library (`/library/transform-sets`).

TransportRequest.description: Play, stop or record (from `tick` when given), or locate the playhead to `tick`.

TransportStatus.description: The playhead: state and position, in samples and ticks.

UndoHistory.description: The undo stack (most recent first) and the redo stack (next first).

VarispeedSettings.description:
Varispeed: while enabled, the whole project plays at `speed` (0.5…1.5) of its tempo; the server compiles it
(every position scaled by 1/speed), and the transport reports compiled samples.
